texts.zh:
我们正在讨论是否要协助[fleet.GetName]建立一个独立的佣兵城邦。这项提议最先是由舰队司令提出，并且如果通过，将会导致我们失去对舰队的控制权。我们还将负责向他们提供一笔可观的能量币和合金，不过作为回报，他们会给我们一些公司的股份，这将带来定期红利和特权。

他们保证，一旦我们需要，他们将随时准备为我们而战，当然也为我们的钱也可以。
texts.en:
We are debating whether or not to help set up the [fleet.GetName] as an independent Mercenary Enclave. The proposal, first put forward by the fleet commanders, would result in us losing control of the fleet. We would also be responsible for providing them with a sizeable investment in Energy Credits and Alloys. In return, they would give us a number of shares in the company. These would come with periodic dividends and special privileges.

They assure us that in times of need, they will always be ready to fight for us. And our money.

texts.zh: 我方舰队已经成功瓦解了位于[merc_system.GetName]星系中佣兵们的抵抗，他们的基地也一并四分五裂。随着剩余的[FROM.GetName]相继崩溃，他们的残留舰队也随之解散。尽管部分还活着的舰长们沦落为海盗，但另一些则是宣称他们将计划继续提供一些小型合约服务，像是提供后勤支持或者是保卫空间站。但这样的小事无关紧要，重要的是，佣兵城邦已经不复存在，我们能够从它的残骸中打捞到相当数量的资源。
texts.en: Our fleet has overcome the defenses of the mercenaries in [merc_system.GetName], and their station has been blown to pieces. The rest of the [FROM.GetName] collapsed quickly after, and their remaining fleets have disbanded. While some of the surviving captains may turn to piracy, others have announced their plans to honor smaller contracts, offering logistical support or space station garrisoning. But such trifling affairs are of little consequence. The important fact is that the Mercenary Enclave is no more, and from its wreckage we have been able to salvage a sizable amount of resources.

texts.zh: 有消息传来，[mercenary_destroyer.GetName]日前在[merc_system.GetName]星系中摧毁了一个佣兵城邦。由于进攻者过于强大，[FROM.GetName]独木难支，他们的董事会，兵营以及船坞均被摧毁。不久后佣兵舰队也随之解散，因为各位舰长都只能自谋生路了，但其中一部分代表声称他们仍将尽力履行公司在后勤以及恒星基地防卫的合约。
texts.en: Word has reached us that a Mercenary Enclave has been destroyed by the [mercenary_destroyer.GetName] in [merc_system.GetName]. The aggressors proved too strong for the [FROM.GetName] to face on their own, and the station housing the Board, barracks, and their shipyards was destroyed. The mercenary fleet disbanded shortly after, as every captain was left to fend for themselves, but some representatives have stated that they will honor the company's contracts in logistics and starbase garrisoning as best they can despite the dissolution of the Company.
